dct_description_sm: For preservation purposes, 'flat file' versions of the multi-spreadsheet Excel workbooks contained in this dataset have been created. The content of these Excel workbooks,  have been exported into preservation-friendly formats and stored in the Preservation Files zip archive.

The dataset is for the expriment that evaluated the impact of lysine, methionine, and histidine deficiencies on gene expression and upstream transcriptional regulators in bovine mammary epithelial cells by RNA-sequencing.
dct_title_s: Impact of lysine, methionine, and histidine deficiencies on gene expression and upstream transcriptional regulators in bovine mammary epithelial cells: an RNA-sequencing analysis
